g.text: $ contractwatch check
ContractWatch
✗ [ERROR]
CW101 Removed endpoint
— DELETE /users/{user_id}
Endpoint DELETE /users/{user_id} is no longer exposed.
impact: Existing clients calling this route will receive 404 responses.
How to fix: Restore DELETE /users/{user_id}, or accept the removal explicitly.
- Locate the FastAPI route that previously handled DELETE /users/{user_id}.
- Re-register the route, or move it to a path/version you intend to keep.
- If the removal is intentional, run: contractwatch baseline update
$ contractwatch baseline update
✗ [ERROR]
CW102 Removed response field
— GET /users/{user_id}
Response field 'email' was removed.
impact: Existing clients may still read 'email' from the response.
How to fix: Add 'email' back to the response model, or accept the break.
- Find the response model used by GET /users/{user_id}.
- Re-add the 'email' attribute with its original type.
- If intentional, run: contractwatch baseline update
$ contractwatch baseline update
! [WARNING]
RL101 Blocking call in async endpoint
time.sleep is a blocking call inside async function 'get_user'
at app/main.py:17 (app.main)
impact: May block the event loop under load, increasing latency.
How to fix: Replace with an async equivalent or run in a threadpool.
- Use httpx.AsyncClient with timeouts instead of requests.
- Replace time.sleep with asyncio.sleep or run_sync.
- Consider using anyio.to_thread.run_sync for CPU/IO blocking work.
$ pytest -q
Contract guard blocked this change.
checked app.main:app
(3 findings, 2 blocking, 0 errors, 4ms)
vs app.main:app
